pages.source:
Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 05-Feb-2025 (01:00 PM - 04:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CSE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - FEBRUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CSE_1171 - PROGRAMMING FOR PROBLEM SOLVING  
  (MAKEUP)  
  Programming for Problem Solving [CSE-1171]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Write the algorithm to find the Sum and Mean of first N natural numbers.                              (2)  
1B)               Outline the main phases in the C program development process and explain why each step is             (3)  
  important.  
1C)               i) Evaluate the expression by showing all the intermediate steps how the following expression is      (5)  
  evaluated. Consider the initial values of i=8, j=5.  
  2*((i/5)+(4*(j-3))%(i+j-2))  
  $$K = (i > 5 ? (i< = 10 ? 100 : 200) : 500)$$  
  ii) Write a program to check if the given number is even or odd and positive or negative using  
  nested conditional operator.  
  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
2A)               Why does the following do-while loop lead to an infinite loop? Fix the error and make changes in      (2)  
  the program to display only odd numbers.  
  
  
2B)               Write a program to display the given pattern using nested while loops.                                (3)  
  
  
2C)               i) Write a C program to find union and intersection of two 1D arrays.                                 (5)  
  
  ii) Implement the C program to find the substring in the main string. Print the count of words  
  repeated and their positions. Given below a sample input and output:  
  
  Enter main string: There is a mat inside a mat  
  Enter sub-string: mat  
  Substring is present 2 time(s) at position(s) 4 7  
  (2+3 = 5 marks)  
  
  Page #1

3A)     Explain different ways of initialization of 2D arrays with example syntax.                               (2)  
3B)   An organization wants to track the weekly attendance (for present: 1 and for absent: 0) of 8 employees (3)  
  over 5 days. Illustrate using a C program to calculate the attendance percentage for each employee  
  and print the employee(s) having less than 75% attendance.  
  
  
3C)     Write a C program to read a 2-dimensional integer array (square matrix) and display the array using (5)  
  displayMatrix() function. Find the sum of principal diagonal elements and Square Root of sum of  
  squares of elements of a matrix using appropriate functions. Display them in main() function.  
4A)     Differentiate between passing arguments by value and by reference with example C programs for            (3)  
  each.  
4B)     Define the recursive function int sum(int n) that returns the sum of the first n natural numbers. In the (3)  
  main function, prompt the user for a positive integer input, call the sum function, and print the result.  
4C)     Explain the process of passing a 2D array to a function in C, and write a program to calculate the       (4)  
  average of elements of a 2x3 matrix.  
5A)     Write a C program to manage product records using an array of structures. The program should             (3)  
  allow the user to:  
  i) Input Data for 3 Products: Each product should have a name, product ID, and sales figures for  
  three different months (sales1, sales2, sales3).  
  ii) Compute and display the Average Sales: Calculate the average sales for each product over the  
  three months.  
  
  
  Page #2

Sample Input:  
  
Enter data for Product 1:  
  
Name: Widget A  
  
Product ID: 161  
  
Sales for Month 1: 500  
  
Sales for Month 2: 600  
  
Sales for Month 3: 700  
  
Enter data for Product 2:  
  
Name: Gadget B  
  
Product ID: 102  
  
Sales for Month 1: 300  
  
Sales for Month 2: 400  
  
Sales for Month 3: 500  
Sample Output:  
  
Product Records and Average Sales:  
  
Product 1:  
  
Name: Widget A  
  
Product ID: 101  
  
Sales for 3 Months: 500, 600, 700  
  
Average Sales: 600.00  
  
Product 2:  
  
Name: Gadget B  
  
Product ID: 162  
  
Sales for 3 Months: 300, 400, 500  
  
Average Sales: 400.00  
  
5B) Write a C program that appends the text "Goodbye!" to an existing file "log.txt". (3)  
5C) Develop a Library Book Management System in C using a pointer to structures. The program (4)  
should allow users to input data for N books, including the title, author name, and the number of  
copies issued for each book. The program should then generate a report displaying the total copies  
issued for each book and the revenue generated, assuming each issued copy generates a fixed  
revenue of \$2.  
Page #3
